text_block_list.text: On the way back from an outing with Fuji Kiseki――

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Huh, you lost your smartphone!?
No matter how many times I turn my bag and pockets inside out, it won't turn up.
That smartphone contains confidential information about Tracen Academy.
choice_data_list: What if the information gets leaked...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That's not good.
We need to find them as soon as possible...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! Trainer, didn't you have
a tablet synced to your smartphone?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "If I recall, there should be an app that lets you track a lost phone from the same account!"
I happened to have it in my bag, so I pulled it out right away, downloaded the app, and configured the settings—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ah! The location info popped up!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The location is... a park, maybe?
Moving all over... the park, right?

Peering closely at the screen,
the phone's current location indicator was indeed darting all over the place.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Did someone pick it up? But it doesn't
look like they're taking it to the police...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...If it's someone dangerous, it'll probably turn into a chase.
I'm gonna go get changed just in case!"
choice_data_list: You don't have to go that far.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
No, you can never be too careful!
Once I get changed, we head out immediately!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Alright, we're here!
But... nobody seems to fit the bill?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, if it's come to this,
I guess we've got no choice but to go around asking people one by one.

text_block_list.name: Cat
text_block_list.text: Nyaan.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Oh! What a cute kitty!
Hey there, have you seen a smartphone around here—"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Huh.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
No, I mean... Look at that smartphone
the kitten is pulling...

Looking closely, a cat was holding a familiar smartphone
with a neck strap in its mouth.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ah, I knew it!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! The culprit was a kitty all along!
Now that's one adorable little criminal!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hey, this is no time to be laughing.
I'll go get it back for you, so just wait there!
No sooner had she said that than she took off after the cat, vanishing from sight in the blink of an eye.
And so, after waiting for a few dozen minutes—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Phew, haah...! Sorry to keep you waiting,
Trainer! I got it back!
Fuji Kiseki returned, drenched to the bone.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, sorry for startling you.
Umm, you see—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Phew, haah... You got me,
that's one quick kitty.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah, kitty, watch out!
That's the pond—!
(*plop!*)

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Eh, no way, it only threw the smartphone!?
That kitty sure is ruthless despite its cute face!?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Whoops, this is bad, I've gotta go grab it fast!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
And that's what happened. But I'm fine, it looks
worse than it is. My undershirt's totally dry!

Despite her words... a faint sheen of sweat covered her brow.
She clearly gave it her all.
choice_data_list: Hand over a drink for now.
I'll go buy a spare shirt right away.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, no no, don't worry about it!
I was searching because I wanted to!"
choice_data_list: Still, you need to stay hydrated.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That's... definitely true.
Ahaha, my throat's completely parched. I didn't even notice.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—Phew!
Thank you! It's super delicious.
choice_data_list: No, thank you for putting in so much effort.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: Because you worked so hard, even getting your clothes dirty.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...You're right!!
Looking closely, there's mud, too... What a terrible state to be in.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Somehow, well, the moment I thought you were in trouble,
I just lost myself in the moment.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Guess I looked pretty uncool there, huh.
choice_data_list: It wasn't uncool at all, it made me really happy.

text_block_list.text:
For Fuji Kiseki, who normally handles everything with such effortless poise, to be putting in so much earnest effort.
Expressing that heartfelt impression in words...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I see. Somehow, hearing you say that
makes me feel a little tickled.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: But I see... So that's how it is.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It's strange, really.
Because I always wanted to look sharp and composed in front of you.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Still, if it brings your smile back,
maybe doing it like this isn't so bad.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Your smile is my greatest treasure, after all.

Together with Fuji Kiseki, who gave me a gentle smile,
I gazed at the setting sun for a while.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Are you sure, though...?
I'm covered in mud right now."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
“I see... Thank you, that really helps!
I'll wash it and return it tomorrow.”

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Haa, thank you. That feels so refreshing.
Your towel is so fluffy, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Besides, somehow... it had a gentle scent.
A soothing, soft aroma.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Fufu, it's hard to notice these things about yourself, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, I've heard that people who smell nice
are genetically compatible with you."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Indeed, this might actually be true.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"If it was for your sake, I wouldn't hesitate
even if it meant diving straight into a pond."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
When I think about that... you might be someone
far more precious to me than I imagined.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Fufu, you don't have to be so shy.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer.
...What kind of existence am I to you?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Do I smell nice, I wonder?

—The next day, when I went to the trainer's office,
a beautifully wrapped towel
had been left there.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
You'd go buy it for me?
Um, but really, I'd feel awful making you do that!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'll be fine!
It'll dry off in no time anyway.
Even so, I can't let her catch a cold.
choice_data_list: It'll just be a sec, so wait a moment!

text_block_list.text:
After running to a nearby convenience store
and hurrying back—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: *inhale*...

I can't just change her clothes myself,
but I can't leave her like this either.
That said, I'd feel bad waking her up.
For now, I decided to carry her back on my back.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Gah!?
Huh, T-Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Sorry,
you fell asleep while waiting, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I knew I was being carried,
but I was half-asleep, so... I thought it was my mother.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Her back felt so reassuring.
Warm and gentle. Just like Mother's back on that day.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...I see, you're just that irreplaceable to them.
That's probably why they got confused."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for saying something so weird.
I just woke up, so my brain isn't fully working yet.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"So, um... we're heading back to the academy, right?
Phew, I need to pull myself together."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...I hope you can forget about what just happened.
After that, I returned to the academy while supporting an unusually spaced-out Fuji Kiseki.
